# Camera, light, self-shadow, and gravity keys on camera3.pmm, their copy,
# paste, delete, and frame lines, a camera VMD save and reload, and new scene.
load pmm camera3.pmm
select camera
frame 30
camera position 1 2 3
camera rotation 10 -20 5
camera distance 25
camera fov 40
register camera
frame 45
light color 200 100 50
light direction 0.5 -1 0.25
register light
frame 50
shadow mode 2
shadow range 8000
register shadow
frame 60
gravity open
gravity magnitude 5
gravity direction 1 -1 0
register gravity
gravity close
save pmm registered.pmm

select all camera
select all light
select all shadow
select all gravity
save vmd camera.vmd

select all camera
copy
frame 100
paste
save pmm pasted.pmm

frame 10
line insert bone
line insert morph
save pmm line-inserted.pmm
frame 5
line delete bone
line delete morph
save pmm line-deleted.pmm

select all camera
frame 101
delete
save pmm deleted.pmm

new
save pmm new.pmm
select camera
load vmd out/camera.vmd
save pmm camera-reloaded.pmm
